hook: Intel built a monospace font with low-vision developers.
hookText: Intel One Mono, built for legibility

beats.say: Intel One Mono is an expressive monospaced font built for clarity and legibility, and it is free with an open-source license. Frere-Jones Type designed it with Intel's brand team.
It was designed for developers with low vision, and a panel of low-vision and legally blind developers gave feedback at every stage, to cut fatigue, eyestrain and coding errors.
It covers over 200 languages using the Latin script, and comes in four weights, Light, Regular, Medium and Bold, each with matching italics.
